event_chain.summary: Unauthorized network access disrupts district systems

summary: On July 20, 2026 Sumner County Schools in Tennessee became aware of unauthorized access to its network. The disruption forced the district to move new-student registration and delay the first day of school from August 4 to August 10, and affected the livestream of a July 21 board meeting. The district brought in the FBI, TBI, Homeland Security and forensic specialists; core network services were restored by late July, and whether any data was taken had not been disclosed.
